Your own place in the woods

Private HOT TUB & SAUNA. We're located in a quiet community, The Forest House is just 20 minutes from Government Camp's winter fun at SkiBowl with skiing, snowboarding, tubing, and cosmic tubing. Timberline and Meadows are only 30 minutes away. A short walk leads you to the Sandy River and local trails. In summer, enjoy the seasonal community pool, river beach, forest campfires, nearby lakes, and endless hiking, making this the perfect year-round getaway.

IG: @CabinForestHouse

The space

Welcome to our recently renovated Forest House, designed with modern touches to make your stay memorable. Step inside to an open, light-filled space with large windows. To maximize the natural light and forest views, our front door features a large, uncovered window (no blinds), blending the indoor living space with the surrounding greenery. The cozy living room features a wood pellet stove, smart TV, and Wi-Fi, flowing into a full kitchen equipped with a 4-burner stove, oven, full-size fridge, microwave, dishwasher, coffee maker, air fryer, blender, and more—everything you need to prepare meals with ease.

Upstairs you'll find three bedrooms: one with two queen beds, and two with one queen bed each. One of these also includes a foldable sofa bed, and the loft-style hallway offers a twin futon and views through three large windows. In the walk-in closet you will find a Pack N' Play that can be used as a bed for your baby or toddler. Each room has its own thermostat for customized comfort. Two full bathrooms, one on each floor, include tub/shower combos.

Outdoors, relax on the deck with a Weber grill, propane fireplace, and natural fire pit (available when no burn bans are in effect). Enjoy birdwatching, stargazing, or simply soaking in the evergreen views. For extra relaxation, guests have PRIVATE ACCESS to both a HOT TUB and SAUNA. When you book, the entire house is yours to enjoy—no shared spaces, just your own private getaway.

Community POOL closed for the season. Opens mid-June 2027

Guest access

The entire house is yours to enjoy during your stay. This includes the backyard with a Hot Tub, patio where you can enjoy the stars lit nights and morning coffee and the garage where you'll find equipment for leisure summer and winter activities. There is room for 3 cars in our driveway. 1 car parked next to the fence on gravel and 2 cars on paved part of the driveway. You can also park on the side of the road.
